custom_logic_notes: wajdyss MMRec (Money Management Recommendation) system: if Lots parameter is negative, uses fixed |Lots|; if positive, uses Lots as fraction of free margin for position sizing. Candle pattern component checks if current candle is bullish (close>open) for longs or bearish (close<open) for shorts. Ichimoku cloud (Kumo) used as trend filter - price must be above cloud for longs, below for shorts. Tenkan/Kijun crossover used as entry trigger. All three conditions must align for entry.
python_conversion_notes: Ichimoku has straightforward pandas-ta implementation. The MMRec conditional lot sizing logic needs explicit branching: negative=fixed lots, positive=margin fraction, zero=auto-calculate from SL and risk percent. Candle pattern check is trivial (close vs open comparison). The new_bar_guard is essential - must track bar time to prevent repeated entries on same bar. Digit adjustment: multiply SL/TP by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
